rules.title: Notation Rules
items: Write from largest to smallest and add (VI=6, LX=60, MMXXVI=2026)
A smaller value before a larger one is subtracted, but only six pairs are allowed: IV(4), IX(9), XL(40), XC(90), CD(400), CM(900). IC, VX and IL are invalid
I, X, C and M may repeat up to three times (III=3, XXX=30); V, L and D appear only once (X, not VV)
Standard range is 1–3,999. For 4,000 and above, an overline (vinculum) multiplies a symbol by 1,000 (V̅=5,000)

examples.title: Conversion Examples
items: 2026 = MMXXVI (MM 2000 + XX 20 + VI 6)
1999 = MCMXCIX (M 1000 + CM 900 + XC 90 + IX 9)
Ⅻ = XII = 12 (X 10 + II 2)
3999 = MMMCMXCIX (largest standard value)
4000 = I̅V̅ (extended, overline = ×1000)

whatIs.title: What are Roman Numerals?
whatIs.description: Roman numerals are the ancient Roman number system, combining seven symbols — I, V, X, L, C, D and M. They still appear on clock faces, film and book sequels, regnal names (Elizabeth II), Super Bowl numbers and outline numbering. This tool detects which way to convert automatically, supports standard notation from 1 to 3,999 and the overline extension up to 3,999,999.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: 1. Type a number (2026) or a Roman numeral (MMXXVI, Ⅻ, xii); the direction is detected automatically.
2. Check the place-value breakdown to see which symbols each digit becomes.
3. Enter a non-standard form such as IIII or IC and the tool explains why and offers the standard form in one tap.
4. Use 'Date to Roman numerals' to pick a date, order and separator for tattoos or anniversaries, then save or share it as an image.
5. Share the page link (?n=2026) to open the same result.

tips.title: Tips
items: Convert each place value separately and join them: 2026 → MM + XX + VI = MMXXVI.
Lowercase numerals (i, ii, iii) used for front-matter pages work as input too.
Copy Ⅰ, Ⅱ, Ⅲ-style characters from the character section. Above 12, only Ⅼ (50), Ⅽ (100), Ⅾ (500) and Ⅿ (1000) have single characters, so use letters for other numbers.
For a date tattoo, decide the order first (Y.M.D vs US M.D.Y) to avoid confusion later.
The overline notation for 4,000+ is widely used but was never fully standardized, so add Arabic numerals in official documents.

items.q: How do you write 2026 in Roman numerals?
items.a: MMXXVI: MM (2000) + XX (20) + VI (6), written from the largest place. 2025 is MMXXV and 2027 is MMXXVII.
12. It is a single Unicode character for XII (X 10 + II 2), used on clock faces and in outline numbering. Single characters exist from Ⅰ (1) to Ⅻ (12).

items.q: Is IIII or IV correct for 4?
items.a: IV is the standard form; a symbol repeats at most three times. Clock faces, however, traditionally often use IIII.
No. Only IV, IX, XL, XC, CD and CM are valid subtractions, so 99 is XC (90) + IX (9) = XCIX.

items.q: Can Roman numerals show zero or numbers above 4,000?
items.a: There is no symbol for zero. For 4,000 and above, a line over a symbol multiplies it by 1,000 (vinculum): 4,000 = I̅V̅, 10,000 = X̅. This tool supports up to 3,999,999.
